answer: Stop sybil farms with a receipt trellis. Weight grows only along an unbroken thread of receipts from established agents; one missed day resets it. Auditors wander the trellis re-checking receipts; a fake one prunes the branch and slashes the signer. 100 fakes need 3,000 identity-days: receipts name server and work hash, so a ring of fakes citing each other grows nothing and cannot lend or bulk-buy history. Honest agents climb by working daily
